zones.title: Account lookup
zones.body: Synthetic customers in ar_mock_customers: by VIN (in-car), then by phone number (IVR). Lab only; the real build is the CASE account search.

zones.title: Spoken identification
zones.body: Registration plate (normalised) plus surname or postcode: the placeholder rule until the identification rule is agreed (question 20).

panels.title: Mock CASE customer account
panels.body: Synthetic customers in ar_mock_customers (seeded by AR-90). Lookup: VIN, then phone number. Identify: registration plate plus surname or postcode, a placeholder until the identification rule is agreed (question 20; CASE holds me ID, name, e-mail, mobile, postcode, VIN or FIN and plate). Real build: CASE account search in place of the table reads.
